card.name: Space before a number in dates
card.fires_on: Mostly the space or punctuation right before a number, such as a day of the month after a month name, a dose number, or a phone digit group. It also appears in a few surname pieces in reference lists.

modes.label: Space before day or dose number
modes.description: A bare space or hyphen just before a digit, often a day after a month name or a dose amount.

modes.label: Inside surnames in citations
modes.description: Part of a person's surname in an author list or reference.

card.plain: It fires on the gap just before a number in dates and doses, and sometimes inside a surname in a reference list.
